description: This file defines utility classes and templates for handling C2 component interfaces, including type mapping, supported value ranges, flags, and parameter field utilities. It provides abstractions for supported values, range checks, and interface trait extraction within the Android media codec framework.

classes.name: C2SupportedRange
classes.description: Utility class representing supported value ranges for a given type, including methods for range creation and validation.

classes.name: C2SupportedFlags
classes.description: Class representing ordered flag sets for a specific type, supporting intersection and containment checks.

classes.name: C2SupportedValueSet
classes.description: Class representing a set of supported values, with methods for containment and intersection.

classes.name: C2FieldSupportedValuesHelper
classes.description: Helper class to manage C2FieldSupportedValues objects for various types, including support checks.

classes.name: C2ParamFieldValuesBuilder
classes.description: Builder class to successively restrict supported values for a parameter field.

classes.name: C2SettingConflictsBuilder
classes.description: Builder class for managing lists of conflicting parameter fields.

classes.name: C2SettingResultBuilder
classes.description: Class providing static methods to create various setting result failure objects.

classes.name: C2FieldUtils
classes.description: Utility class for enumerating and locating parameter fields within C2 parameters.

classes.name: C2InterfaceUtils
classes.description: Utility class for creating traits from C2ComponentInterface objects.

methods.name: _C2FieldValueHelper<T>::put
methods.description: Serializes a primitive value of type T into an output stream.

methods.name: C2SupportedRange<T>::None
methods.description: Creates an empty range with no supported values.

methods.name: C2SupportedRange<T>::Any
methods.description: Creates a range supporting all values.

methods.name: C2SupportedRange<T>::EqualTo
methods.description: Creates a range supporting a single specific value.

methods.name: C2SupportedRange<T>::GreaterThan
methods.description: Creates a range supporting values greater than a specified value.

methods.name: C2SupportedRange<T>::GreaterThanOrEqualTo
methods.description: Creates a range supporting values greater than or equal to a specified value.

methods.name: C2SupportedRange<T>::LessThan
methods.description: Creates a range supporting values less than a specified value.

methods.name: C2SupportedRange<T>::LessThanOrEqualTo
methods.description: Creates a range supporting values less than or equal to a specified value.

methods.name: C2SupportedRange<T>::InRange
methods.description: Creates a continuous or arithmetic range between two values.

methods.name: C2SupportedRange<T>::InSeries
methods.description: Creates a range over a geometric series.

methods.name: C2SupportedRange<T>::InMacSeries
methods.description: Creates a range over a multiply-accumulate series.

methods.name: C2SupportedRange<T>::contains
methods.description: Checks if a value is within the range.

methods.name: C2SupportedRange<T>::limitedTo
methods.description: Returns the intersection of this range with another range.

methods.name: C2SupportedFlags<T>::contains
methods.description: Checks if a flag value is part of the flag set.

methods.name: C2SupportedFlags<T>::limitedTo
methods.description: Returns the intersection of this flag set with another.

methods.name: C2SupportedValueSet<T>::contains
methods.description: Checks if a value is part of the value set.

methods.name: C2SupportedValueSet<T>::limitedTo
methods.description: Returns the intersection of this value set with another set or range.

methods.name: C2FieldSupportedValuesHelper<T>::supports
methods.description: Checks if a value is supported according to the helper.

methods.description: Sets the supported values to any.

methods.name: C2ParamFieldValuesBuilder<T>::none
methods.description: Sets the supported values to none.

methods.name: C2ParamFieldValuesBuilder<T>::greaterThan
methods.description: Restricts supported values to those greater than a specified value.

methods.name: C2ParamFieldValuesBuilder<T>::greaterThanOrEqualTo
methods.description: Restricts supported values to those greater than or equal to a specified value.

methods.name: C2ParamFieldValuesBuilder<T>::notLessThan
methods.description: Restricts supported values to those not less than a specified value.

methods.name: C2ParamFieldValuesBuilder<T>::lessThanOrEqualTo
methods.description: Restricts supported values to those less than or equal to a specified value.

methods.name: C2ParamFieldValuesBuilder<T>::lessThan
methods.description: Restricts supported values to those less than a specified value.

methods.name: C2ParamFieldValuesBuilder<T>::inRange
methods.description: Restricts supported values to a range between min and max with optional step.

methods.name: C2ParamFieldValuesBuilder<T>::inSeries
methods.description: Restricts supported values to a geometric series.

methods.name: C2ParamFieldValuesBuilder<T>::inMacSeries
methods.description: Restricts supported values to a multiply-accumulate series.

methods.name: C2ParamFieldValuesBuilder<T>::oneOf
methods.description: Restricts supported values to a specific list of values.
